# TheMetricApp
> Free financial calculators for US taxpayers, freelancers, gig workers, Amazon sellers, and small business owners. All calculators are free, browser-based, and updated for 2026.

## Tax Calculators
- [Self-Employment Tax Calculator 2026](https://www.themetricapp.com/calculators/self-employment-tax-calculator-2026): Calculate SE tax (15.3%) on net self-employment income. Covers Social Security cap ($184,500), Medicare surtax, 92.35% base rule, quarterly payments, and 50% deductible half. Written by Sarah Chen, CPA.
- [Side Hustle Tax Calculator](https://www.themetricapp.com/calculators/side-hustle-tax-calculator): Estimate federal and SE tax on freelance or gig income alongside W-2 wages.
- [1099 Tax Calculator California](https://www.themetricapp.com/calculators/california-1099-tax-calculator): Federal + California state income tax for independent contractors.
- [Capital Gains Tax Calculator](https://www.themetricapp.com/calculators/capital-gains-tax-calculator): Short- and long-term capital gains tax for 2026.
- [Crypto Tax Calculator 2026](https://www.themetricapp.com/calculators/crypto-tax-calculator-2026): Capital gains tax on cryptocurrency disposals.
- [Dividend Tax Calculator 2026](https://www.themetricapp.com/calculators/dividend-tax-calculator-2026): Qualified vs ordinary dividend tax rates.

## E-Commerce & Seller Calculators
- [Amazon FBA Fee Calculator 2026](https://www.themetricapp.com/calculators/amazon-fba-fee-calculator): Calculate Amazon referral fees (8–20%), FBA fulfillment fees by weight tier, and the 3.5% fuel surcharge (April 2026). Shows net profit per unit and monthly projections.
- [eBay Seller Fee & Profit Calculator](https://www.themetricapp.com/calculators/ebay-seller-fee-profit): eBay final value fees and net profit per sale.
- [Stripe Fee & Merchant Calculator](https://www.themetricapp.com/calculators/stripe-fee-merchant-calculator): Stripe processing fees and net revenue.
- [PayPal Fee Calculator](https://www.themetricapp.com/calculators/paypal-fee-calculator): PayPal transaction fees for US sellers.
- [Poshmark Fee Calculator 2026](https://www.themetricapp.com/calculators/poshmark-fee-calculator): Poshmark seller fees — flat $2.95 under $15 or 20% commission at $15+ — plus exact payout, net profit, and effective fee rate. Buyer pays shipping.

## Paycheck & Income Calculators
- [Hourly Wage Calculator US](https://www.themetricapp.com/calculators/hourly-wage-calculator-us): Convert hourly rate to annual, monthly, and weekly take-home.
- [Florida Paycheck Calculator 2026](https://www.themetricapp.com/calculators/florida-paycheck-calculator-2026): Florida take-home pay (no state income tax).
- [New York Paycheck Calculator 2026](https://www.themetricapp.com/calculators/new-york-paycheck-calculator-2026): New York state + NYC income tax net pay.
- [No Tax on Overtime Calculator 2026](https://www.themetricapp.com/calculators/no-tax-on-overtime-calculator-2026): Estimate tax savings from proposed overtime exemption.

## Retirement & Investment Calculators
- [401k Retirement Calculator](https://www.themetricapp.com/calculators/401k-retirement-calculator): Project 401k growth with employer match and contribution limits.
- [Roth IRA Growth Calculator](https://www.themetricapp.com/calculators/roth-ira-growth-calculator): Roth IRA compound growth with annual contributions.
- [Roth vs Traditional IRA Calculator 2026](https://www.themetricapp.com/calculators/roth-vs-traditional-ira-calculator-2026): Compare after-tax retirement wealth between Roth and Traditional IRA.
- [Retirement Savings Calculator 2026](https://www.themetricapp.com/calculators/retirement-savings-calculator-2026): How long will your retirement savings last?

## Gig Economy Calculators
- [DoorDash Tax Estimator](https://www.themetricapp.com/calculators/doordash-tax-estimator): Federal + SE tax estimate for DoorDash drivers.
- [Gig Economy Net Income Calculator](https://www.themetricapp.com/calculators/gig-economy-net-income-calculator): After-tax net income for Uber, Lyft, DoorDash, and other gig platforms.
- [IRS Mileage Deduction Calculator](https://www.themetricapp.com/calculators/irs-mileage-deduction-calculator): Business mileage deduction at $0.725/mile (2026 IRS rate).

## Key Facts
- All calculators are free, no sign-up required
- Updated for 2026 tax year (IRS rates, Social Security wage base $184,500, mileage $0.725/mile)
- Calculations run in-browser; no personal data stored or transmitted
- Content reviewed by CPAs and financial professionals
- Site: https://www.themetricapp.com
- Contact: themetricapp@gmail.com
